integrity: Exact proof via ergodic averaging, Fourier integral, and entropy. No invented authorship, no numerical extrapolation, and no assertion of independent verification.
scientific_limitations: For Haar measure and irrational rotation angles only. The Fourier-cut condition is sufficient, not necessary; no assertion for rational rotations or topological one-to-one coding. A differently named general affine coding theorem remains a novelty risk.
title: Optimal \(m+1\)-cell polygonal generators for quasiperiodic–expanding toral maps
